mechanisms.name: Ordered re-entrant operation pipeline
mechanisms.mechanism: One step = first applicable Operation over persisted session state (applied / not_applicable / yielded + effects). Approval, compaction, retry, steering, subagents are all steps in the ordered pipeline, not branches in a loop.
mechanisms.borrow: Forge Conductor step engine with applicable(state)->outcome; policies as operations; every policy visible as a ledger step.
mechanisms.risk: re-entrancy requires idempotent effects; otherwise replay double-drives Craft

mechanisms.name: Single-step contract + append-only trajectory
mechanisms.mechanism: Each step returns a typed StepOutput (thought, action, observation, done, submission, exit_status); the trajectory record, not the chat, is the unit persisted each iteration.
mechanisms.borrow: Episode Ledger row schema; done is a field, never a control-flow side effect.
mechanisms.risk: trajectory must be bounded and rolled/compacted

mechanisms.name: Bounded repair on format errors, abort on environment errors
mechanisms.mechanism: Model-format failures get a targeted correction quoting the offending artifact, under a hard requery budget; environment failures stop and salvage. Aider applies the good blocks and explains the failed ones.
mechanisms.borrow: Gateway error taxonomy SCHEMA_INVALID / PRECONDITION_UNMET / NO_MATCH / TIMEOUT / DENIED / ENVIRONMENT with per-step and per-episode repair budgets; partial-apply semantics for batches.
mechanisms.risk: repair loops burn budget on impossible tasks; bound and record counts

mechanisms.name: Tools as declarative records from one authoritative definition
mechanisms.mechanism: One record per tool (name, prose, typed args, terminator) generates both prompt documentation and machine schema, so they cannot drift.
mechanisms.borrow: Command Atlas generates gateway JSON schema + prompt docs mechanically, with CI parity check.
mechanisms.risk: doc-derived schemas are fragile; validate at build time and fail the build

mechanisms.name: One tool namespace across native, CLI and MCP
mechanisms.mechanism: Origin is encoded in the tool id (mcp://server/tool) and schemas normalized at the boundary, so the model sees one flat list regardless of transport.
mechanisms.borrow: craft://family/command id resolved to in-app IPC, CLI, or MCP; policy enforced once at the gateway.
mechanisms.risk: name collisions across servers; require deterministic prefixes + hard collision error

mechanisms.name: Capability-gated tool exposure
mechanisms.mechanism: Advertised tools are a projection of the session's capability set; one switch cuts schema tokens, blast radius and destructive choice risk.
mechanisms.borrow: Craft capability profiles (inspect / edit / export / batch) selecting gateway commands, recorded per episode.
mechanisms.risk: hand-maintained capability lists rot; derive from atlas families with coverage assertions

mechanisms.name: Composable condenser pipeline over a view, with pinned head
mechanisms.mechanism: History is immutable; memory is a View; condensation is a recorded event replacing a range; condensers chain and the first Condensation short-circuits; a small head is always preserved.
mechanisms.borrow: ledger -> view -> condensers -> prompt; condensation as an event so resume rebuilds the exact view.
mechanisms.risk: event-count trigger is not a token budget; replace trigger with measured tokens

mechanisms.name: Continuation-note compaction with an epistemic contract
mechanisms.mechanism: Summary is written for the successor agent: goal, state, decisions, unfinished work, verification status, facts vs assumptions, injection guard, bounded length; previous summary carried forward.
mechanisms.borrow: Episode Ledger compaction record shape; write original prompt to this shape.
mechanisms.risk: fact/assumption split unenforceable by prompt; pair with machine checks; note is a lossy view

mechanisms.name: Token-budget compaction with cost-tier headroom + preserved recent tokens
mechanisms.mechanism: Trigger = min(ratio x context, limit - headroom) where limit is a cost tier boundary; a reserve of recent tokens stays verbatim.
mechanisms.borrow: Craft computes budget from real window and cost tier, config-overridable, emits telemetry when compaction fires.
mechanisms.risk: provider constants rot; test that threshold stays below window

mechanisms.name: Assertions as first-class tools over stable element refs
mechanisms.mechanism: Postconditions are asserted by tools that return a normal tool result; targets come from a structured snapshot with stable refs; structured snapshot preferred over pixels.
mechanisms.borrow: Craft document-model snapshot with refs, assertion vocabulary, postcondition registry per command; pixels secondary.
mechanisms.risk: accessibility tree is not a canvas; Craft needs an object-model projection

mechanisms.name: Decidable acceptance checks with explicit UNVERIFIED
mechanisms.mechanism: Acceptance decided in code over decidable criteria; undecidable or cross-sandbox criteria return checked=false (UNVERIFIED) rather than pass; vocabulary reserves satisfied/verified/passed for execution evidence.
mechanisms.borrow: Conductor refuses to finish an episode while a required criterion is UNVERIFIED; Craft checks are file exists, artifact opens, layer delta, colour applied, document saved.
mechanisms.risk: model-authored criteria are an injection surface; whitelist check kinds and validate args

mechanisms.name: Fail-closed dual-mode checkpoints + state-only rollback
mechanisms.mechanism: Checkpoints carry their storage mode and fail closed on mismatch instead of materializing empty state; rollback goes through the same state accessor as normal writes.
mechanisms.borrow: Craft checkpoints carry schema_version + writer id; mismatch refuses; undo is a recorded ledger replay.
mechanisms.risk: borrow the invariant, not the LangGraph plumbing

craftBuild.name: Command Gateway
craftBuild.purpose: single dispatch chokepoint for every Craft mutation
craftBuild.inputs: episode_id, step, command_id craft://family/name, args, capability_profile, idempotency_key, budget, dry_run
tests: same idempotency key twice => one side effect
craftBuild.failureMode: transport-level success without document change; only the postcondition check catches it

craftBuild.name: Visual Verification
craftBuild.outputs: snapshot tree with stable refs; per-assertion {holds, evidence_path, label}
tests: assertion on missing ref fails cleanly
assertion passes only on real match
canvas project still yields usable snapshot
craftBuild.failureMode: model narrates a screenshot instead of tool-returned holds

craftBuild.name: Episode Ledger
craftBuild.purpose: append-only evidence chain that makes resume, undo and evaluation possible
craftBuild.inputs: ledger events (episode_started, plan_set, step, command_result, verification, checkpoint, compaction, approval_decided, subagent_result, episode_finished)
craftBuild.outputs: rebuildable view, checkpoint records, hash chain, evidence labels V/R/I/U
tests: restore with bumped schema_version fails closed
craftBuild.failureMode: silent success from a subagent with no decidable check
